title: Advertising on FoodFen
description: Put your restaurant in the "Sponsored" section of the app.

noRestaurant.message: You need to create your restaurant before buying ads.

rules.eligibility: Your payment makes the whole restaurant eligible to appear in the app's "Sponsored" section.
rules.relevance: Your dishes are only shown to users whose nutrition goals they fit.
rules.limit: At most 3 restaurants are shown at a time, so impressions are not guaranteed.
rules.extension: Buying a package while your ad is still running adds time on top of the current end date.
rules.refund: No refund if your restaurant is taken down for breaking the moderation rules.

status.paused: Your package runs until {{date}}, but your ad is hidden because the restaurant is not approved or was taken down.

order.pendingBody: This page updates on its own once the payment is done.
order.paidBody: Your restaurant's advertising time has been extended.
order.failedBody: The order was not paid. You can pick a package and try again.

picker.title: Choose a package
picker.notApproved: Your restaurant must be approved before you can buy ads.
picker.none: There are no ad packages available right now.
